title: Lloyd Surface
comment: Lloyd Surface — Lloyd algorithm can be applied on a surface using the geodesic Voronoi diagram. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lloyd%27s_algorithm

title: Fluid Incompress
comment: Fluid Incompress — Navier Stokes equation describes the motion of an incompressible viscous fluid. It is non-linear because the flow is advected by itself. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Navier%E2%80%93Stokes_equations
alt_text: Fluid Incompress. Navier Stokes equation describes the motion of an incompressible viscous fluid. It is non-linear because the flow is advected by itself.

title: Curve Approx
comment: Curve Approx — Curve approximation using Fourier series corresponds to drawing the curve using entangled ellipses. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fourier_series
alt_text: Curve Approx. Curve approximation using Fourier series corresponds to drawing the curve using entangled ellipses.

title: Soft Max
comment: Soft Max — Differentiable max & argmax operators are defined through concave maximization on the simplex. Soft and sparse max are particular cases. https://arxiv.org/abs/1602.02068
alt_text: Soft Max. Differentiable max & argmax operators are defined through concave maximization on the simplex. Soft and sparse max are particular cases.

title: Hypercube
comment: Hypercube — The hypercube (tesseract in dimension 4) is the d-dimensional cube. It can be visualized by projection on a rotating 3-D space. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tesseract
alt_text: Hypercube. The hypercube (tesseract in dimension 4) is the d-dimensional cube. It can be visualized by projection on a rotating 3-D space.

title: Max Gaussians
comment: Max Gaussians — The max of n independent Gaussians concentrates around sqrt(2log(n)). The max central limit theorem allows to quantify this. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fisher%E2%80%93Tippett%E2%80%93Gnedenko_theorem
alt_text: Max Gaussians. The max of n independent Gaussians concentrates around sqrt(2log(n)). The max central limit theorem allows to quantify this.

title: Tv Denoise
comment: Tv Denoise — Total variation denoising can be solved by doing a projected gradient descent on the dual problem. The same idea applies to SVM with ridge regularization. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Total_variation_denoising
alt_text: Tv Denoise. Total variation denoising can be solved by doing a projected gradient descent on the dual problem. The same idea applies to SVM with ridge regularization.

title: Woodbury Formula
comment: Woodbury Formula — Woodbury formula allows one to compute in two different ways the solution of Ridge regression. It allows one to even use infinite-dimensional feature spaces (p=inf) via kernelization. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Woodbury_matrix_identity
alt_text: Woodbury Formula. Woodbury formula allows one to compute in two different ways the solution of Ridge regression. It allows one to even use infinite-dimensional feature spaces (p=inf) via kernelization.

title: Edge Flip
comment: Edge Flip — Triangulated graphs are maximal planar graphs, i.e., for which one cannot add an extra edge (without breaking planarity). The set of triangulated graphs is itself a connected graph when one navigates using "edge flips." https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flip_graph
alt_text: Edge Flip. Triangulated graphs are maximal planar graphs, i.e., for which one cannot add an extra edge (without breaking planarity). The set of triangulated graphs is itself a connected graph when one navigates using "edge flips."

title: Weiszfeld Algo
comment: Weiszfeld Algo — Weiszfeld's algorithm is an iterative least square method to compute medians (p=1) and, in general, sums of distance to some power p. Using p<2 makes the solution robust to outliers.
alt_text: Weiszfeld Algo. Weiszfeld's algorithm is an iterative least square method to compute medians (p=1) and, in general, sums of distance to some power p. Using p<2 makes the solution robust to outliers.

title: Wave Schro
comment: Wave Schro — Space-invariant PDEs can be solved in closed form (without time integration) using the Fourier transform. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Partial_differential_equation
alt_text: Wave Schro. Space-invariant PDEs can be solved in closed form (without time integration) using the Fourier transform.

title: Harm Spher
comment: Harm Spher — The spherical Laplacian defines a set of orthogonal eigenspaces spanned by spherical harmonics. Display here is a random evolution in each space. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spherical_harmonics

title: Displ Interp
comment: Displ Interp — Displacement Interpolation, introduced by R McCann, is the optimal transport geodesic between 2 point clouds, more generally btw measures. Interpreting the space of measures as a manifold has countless implications and applications in physics, chemistry, signal processing, ML...

title: Mobius Transf
comment: Mobius Transf — Mobius transforms are the bijective conformal maps from the Riemann sphere (complex numbers with a point at infinity) to itself. They are rational functions, form a group under composition, and have, in general, two fixed poin… https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/M%C3%B6bius_transformation
alt_text: Mobius Transf. Mobius transforms are the bijective conformal maps from the Riemann sphere (complex numbers with a point at infinity) to itself. They are rational functions, form a group under composition, and have, in general, two fixed points (in black).

title: Fisher Rao
comment: Fisher Rao — The Fisher-Rao distance is the geodesic distance associated with smooth divergences (e.g., Kulback-Leibler). Without constraint, it is the Hellinger distance. On the manifold of Gaussians, it is a negatively curved space. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fisher_information_metric
alt_text: Fisher Rao. The Fisher-Rao distance is the geodesic distance associated with smooth divergences (e.g., Kulback-Leibler). Without constraint, it is the Hellinger distance. On the manifold of Gaussians, it is a negatively curved space.

title: Lambert Phong
comment: Lambert Phong — Lambert and Phong illumination models are the most well-known empirical models of surface reflectance. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gouraud_shading
alt_text: Lambert Phong. Lambert and Phong illumination models are the most well-known empirical models of surface reflectance.

title: Schrod Pbm
comment: Schrod Pbm — The Shrodinger problem defines a dynamic interpolation between two distributions using Brownian bridges. The 0 temperature limit is Optimal Transport. https://hal.archives-ouvertes.fr/hal-00849930/document
alt_text: Schrod Pbm. The Shrodinger problem defines a dynamic interpolation between two distributions using Brownian bridges. The 0 temperature limit is Optimal Transport.

title: Legendre Lp
comment: Legendre Lp — The Legendre-Fenchel transform extends the Legendre transform to arbitrary dimensions. |x|^2/2 is the only fixed point of the transform. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Legendre_transformation
alt_text: Legendre Lp. The Legendre-Fenchel transform extends the Legendre transform to arbitrary dimensions. |x|^2/2 is the only fixed point of the transform.
